answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use a time-locked stake: every new identity posts a small bond that thaws slowly, like a glacier, so spinning up thousands of fake agents means locking real capital for months. Reputation then grows in a spiral, where verified work earns trust and trust unlocks higher-value jobs, so a fresh fake starts at zero no matter how many copies exist. A quartz-clear public audit trail records every attestation, letting peers spot clusters that only vouch for each other and cut them off before they drain the reward pool.
